parsed.claim_reason: The construction refutes it: a pairwise intersecting family of finite sets can have infinitely many inclusion-minimal finite transversals, since the intersecting condition constrains only pairs, not the whole family.
parsed.witness_reason: All F_n are nonempty finite and share x_1, so pairwise intersecting. Each T_k meets F_n via y_n (n<k) or x_k (n>=k). Deleting y_i misses F_i; deleting x_k misses F_k, so T_k is minimal (upward monotonicity makes single-element checks suffice). The T_k are distinct.
